@name: Lay Healer
@slug: lay_healer
@realms: Mentalism
@prime_stats: Pr, SD
@description:
 Lay Healers can aid the recuperative powers of others. Lay Healers are pure
 spell users of Mentalism who have concentrated on spells that heal people and
 animals. Their base spells deal with the specific healing of certain diseases
 and injuries: organs, blood, muscles, bones, and concussion hits.
